_comment: TEMPLATE: aggregate nameset. Aggregates compose names from multiple source namesets with per-source weights, optional per-source overrides, and per-slot mixing policies.
_validate_note: On its own this template will trigger 'source not found' errors from the validate command — the source namesets ('east-asian-evolved', 'core:russian', etc.) are referenced for illustration. Replace them with real nameset IDs from your campaign. Missing sources at runtime degrade gracefully (warn + skip with reduced effective weight pool).
_comment_namespace: Aggregates live in their own namespace; they reference sources by bare ID (resolved within current namespace, then root) or qualified 'namespace:id'.
name: Core Worlds Cosmopolitan
description: The polyglot population of the inner systems. Mostly old Earth descent with heavy diaspora mixing.
_comment_type: Required for aggregates. Without it the loader treats the file as a leaf and the 'sources' array is ignored.
_comment_formats: Aggregates have their own formats; the format determines slot identifiers. Source namesets contribute the slot VALUES, not the format itself.

naval.when: Aboard ship or in formal naval correspondence.

sources._comment: Plain source: weight controls relative probability; label is shown by --show-group and --explain.
sources.label: east-asian

sources._comment: Cross-namespace reference: 'core:russian' is the bundled namespace's russian nameset. Per-source override biases gender and filters entries by tag.
sources.label: russian-military

sources._comment: Nested aggregate: this source itself resolves to another aggregate, which then picks ITS own source. Generation recurses until a leaf is hit.
sources.label: frontier

sources._comment: If the referenced nameset is missing, validate flags it as an error and runtime degrades gracefully (warn + skip with reduced effective weight pool).
sources.label: habitat

slots._comment: Per-slot source-selection policies. The first slot in the format string is the 'anchor' — it always rolls fresh. Other slots default to 'inherit' (same source as the anchor) for coherent names. Override here for diaspora effects.
slots._comment_firstName: First slot is the anchor; 'inherit' is the default for non-anchor slots and is a no-op for the anchor itself.
slots._comment_lastName: Mix policy: 30% of the time roll independently from sources (cross-mix), 70% inherit the anchor source. Use this for diaspora-rate naming (e.g. Sanskrit first + Scarrow last).
slots._comment_middleName: Independent: always roll fresh from sources, ignoring the anchor's choice.
slots._comment_rank: Forced: always pull this slot from the named nameset, regardless of which source the anchor picked. Useful for cross-cutting axes (titles, ranks, honorifics) shared across all sources.
